brief:
Fatah's latest call for Palestinian national dialogue follows a familiar pattern, Shehab Wire reported. Palestinians have witnessed repeated cycles of invitations, communications, and arrangements followed by postponed dates or shifting priorities that return negotiations to square one.

The movement's appeal for dialogue itself presents no inherent problem, but the track record of delays and abandoned timelines has eroded confidence in such initiatives among Palestinians.

title: Fatah calls for national dialogue amid history of postponement
